display_information.name: ScaledAI Executive Assistant
display_information.description: Private assistant for the CEO. Answers his questions in a direct message from DD and his email. Never posts as him.
display_information.long_description: The ScaledAI Executive Assistant is a private, owner-only assistant connected to DelegationDoer (DD). Only the CEO can use it: it answers his questions in its direct message with him, using DD records, his email and, once he allows it, the Slack conversations he can see. It never reads lead or patient-intake channels, DMs with bots, or conversations he isn't part of except public channels he chooses. It never posts in channels and never posts as anyone. Other people who open it see that it is private. Data is kept in DD for a limited time and deleted when reading stops or the app is removed. Support: the ScaledAI operations team.
